text:
Usually you don't need neither DLSS or frame gen to play Rasterized or Ray traced games.

To use Path Tracing, on the other hand, is another story. 

When you understand how PT works you see why is amazing that we can even have it in real time and in 4K in games like Cyberpunk.

Each pixel traces a ray from the camera to objects and bounces multiple times to calculate light  behaviour and reflexes.

In Unreal, a 60 sec raster animation can be rendered in 1 minute.
While a Path Tracing animation will take 30 minutes (I have a video demonstrating it)

It's fantastic, but near impossible to happen without help from the new tecs.
